text: When removing the battery, disconnect the black negative (-ve) terminal bolt first, then the red positive (+ve) terminal bolt. Both bolts are undone with the 10 mm spanner from the tool kit. Watch out: Keep the red (+ve) and black (-ve) cables firmly connected to their battery terminals. A loose connection may damage the motorcycle's electrical system.

answer.text: When removing the battery, disconnect the black negative (-ve) terminal bolt first, then the red positive (+ve) terminal bolt. Both bolts are undone with the 10 mm spanner from the tool kit.
When refitting the battery, connect the red positive (+ve) terminal first, then the black negative (-ve) terminal.
